subject: Scope sanitization & upload window: Brightleaf Whistic profile (sensitive artifacts plan)
messages:
From: Carla Mendes <carla@brightleaf.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: security@brightleaf.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Whistic profile: scope scrub + upload window for sensitive artifacts

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. We finished our internal review and have a small set of artifacts that contain PCI-related screenshots and sensitive internal runbooks. We need help getting our Whistic profile cleaned so we can publish the public-facing fields without exposing those files.

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood accept a redacted bundle and provide a workflow for ephemeral upload (we prefer SFTP + temp creds or a short-lived pre-signed S3 option)?
2) We need a 2-hour coordinated upload window next week (PST) so our security team can validate redactions and purge temp copies.

I've attached a CSV manifest with current file names. Also, which CAIQ/SIG questions typically require the original screenshots vs an excerpt? We want to avoid unnecessary disclosure.

Carla
Carla Mendes
Security Operations, Brightleaf
carla@brightleaf.com

Attachment: brightleaf_manifest_v1.csv

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Carla Mendes <carla@brightleaf.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Whistic profile: scope scrub + upload window for sensitive artifacts

Hi Carla — thanks for the clear ask and the manifest.

Summary of proposed approach:
- Step 1 (pre-window): Brightleaf uploads a redacted bundle to a staging SFTP endpoint or provides pre-signed URLs. Use manifest_template.csv format (attached) and mark files that are "sensitive".
- Step 2 (validation window): Redwood ops stands by during a 2-hour window to pull, verify redactions against a CAIQ mapping (we'll only request originals for items explicitly required by SOC2/SIG reviewers).
- Step 3 (post-window): Redwood deletes all staging copies within 24 hours and returns a signed receipt of possession for records.

Logistics we need from you:
- Confirm preferred transfer method: SFTP (we can provision a temp user) or S3 presign flows.
- Timezone and three preferred dates/times (PST).
- A brief mapping of which CAIQ/SIG questions you expect will need unredacted evidence (if any).

I've copied Ben (security integrations) and Marissa (portal operations) to coordinate the SFTP credentials and the manifest format. Attached is our manifest_template.csv and an internal SFTP upload checklist.

If that works, propose a window and we'll hold it.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Security Integrations Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Attachment: manifest_template.csv; sftp_upload_instructions.txt

From: Carla Mendes <carla@brightleaf.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Whistic profile: scope scrub + upload window for sensitive artifacts

Thanks Jonas — that plan looks good. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- We prefer S3 presigns because our comms team can generate presigned links quickly from an internal bucket with short TTLs. Is Redwood able to consume presigned uploads directly or do you require SFTP for chain-of-custody controls?
- Retention: can Redwood confirm deletion semantics and whether you provide a signed evidence-of-destruction? We need that for our audit folder.
- Key management: our security team wants assurance that any temporary copy in Redwood's staging is encrypted with a KMS key and access is limited to the ops engineers on the call.

We propose two windows (PST):
- Tue Dec 1, 11:00–13:00 PST
- Wed Dec 2, 09:00–11:00 PST

I've re-attached the manifest (brightleaf_manifest_v1.csv) with columns: filename, redaction_level (none/partial/full), expected_caiaq_refs.

Carla

Carla — all good, thanks for the windows. We can support S3 presigns and will provide the following guarantees:

- S3 presign ingestion: Redwood will pull files from your presigned URLs directly into a temporary bucket encrypted with our KMS key (customer-upload staging key), and access will be restricted to the two engineers on the call.
- Deletion: we will run an automated wipe and then produce a signed deletion receipt (hash of deleted filenames + timestamp) within 24 hours.
- Originals: during the validation window we will only request originals for items you flagged with "require_original" in expected_caiaq_refs. Otherwise we'll accept redacted artifacts.

We can hold Tue Dec 1, 11:00–13:00 PST. Ben will send the Zoom invite and an operations checklist; Marissa will provision a short-lived ingest role and share the temporary KMS encryption label.

Please reply with a confirmation and we'll send the calendar invite + a short runbook.

— Jonas
